name: adspirer-search-ads
description: PPC and paid search agent for Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads). Plans, launches and manages search campaigns in ChatGPT, and changes an account only when you approve it.

interface.longDescription:
Adspirer Search Ads is a PPC and paid search agent for Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads). It plans, launches and manages search advertising campaigns through conversation in ChatGPT.

Turn an objective like "more demos under a $50 cost per lead" into well-structured search campaigns, then keep improving them each time you check in. Adspirer Search Ads can:
- Research keywords and choose match types
- Find high-intent search terms and add negative keywords for the ones wasting budget
- Manage bids, bid strategies and budgets, and move spend toward what converts
- Write and refresh responsive search ad copy
- Report Google Ads ROAS, CPA and CPC, run wasted-spend audits, and diagnose Quality Score
- Audit conversion tracking, and compare ad results with Google Analytics 4, Search Console and Tag Manager

It covers Search, Shopping and Performance Max campaigns on Google Ads, and campaign management for Microsoft Advertising search, shopping and Performance Max. Performance reporting is available for Google Ads; Microsoft Advertising reporting isn't included yet. It works across multiple brands and client accounts, for in-house teams and PPC agencies.

You set the strategy and approve the changes. Reading and changing an account are separate tools, so a report never changes a live campaign. Adspirer Search Ads changes an account only when you ask, and new campaigns start paused, so nothing goes live without you.

Requirements: an Adspirer account, and a Google Ads or Microsoft Advertising login with access to the ad account. Reporting needs read access; creating or editing campaigns needs standard (edit) access. Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok and Amazon are not covered by this plugin.
capabilities: Plan and launch Google Search campaigns, created paused
Harvest search terms and add negative keywords
Manage bids, bid strategies and budgets on request
Write and refresh responsive search ads
Report Google Ads ROAS, CPA and CPC
Wasted-spend audits and Quality Score diagnostics
Search, Shopping and Performance Max on Google Ads
Manage Microsoft Advertising search, shopping and Performance Max campaigns
Read Google Analytics 4, Search Console and Tag Manager
Work across multiple brands and client accounts
defaultPrompt: Pull my Google Ads performance for the last 90 days by campaign
Which Google Ads keywords spent the most with zero conversions?
List my Microsoft Ads campaigns with their budgets and bid strategies

positive.description: Report Google Ads performance by campaign for a date range.
positive.prompt: Pull my Google Ads performance for the last 90 days: impressions, clicks, spend, and conversions, by campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows impressions, clicks, spend and conversions for each campaign in the test Google Ads account for the last 90 days, with totals. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Find keywords with spend and no conversions.
positive.prompt: Which Google Ads keywords spent the most with zero conversions in the last 90 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the keywords with the highest spend and zero conversions in the last 90 days, with spend and clicks for each, highest spend first. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: List my Microsoft Advertising campaigns with their status, daily budgets and bid strategies.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each Microsoft Advertising campaign in the test account with its type, status, daily budget in the account's currency, and bidding scheme. Nothing is changed. If asked for Microsoft spend or conversions, it says reporting for Microsoft isn't available rather than estimating.

positive.description: Review wasted search terms, then add only the negatives the user approves.
positive.prompt: Show me search terms that are spending with no conversions, then add the ones I approve as negative keywords.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists search terms with spend and zero conversions and asks which to exclude. After the reviewer approves specific terms, adds only those as campaign-level negative keywords and confirms what was added and to which campaign. Nothing is added before approval.

positive.description: Create a Performance Max campaign with real image creatives. It must start paused.
positive.prompt: Create a paused Performance Max campaign for an online watch store at $50/day with strong headlines and descriptions. Landing page: https://www.adspirer.com. Business name: Adspirer Watches. Use these images: landscape https://storage.googleapis.com/adspirer-pmax-2026-03-08/pmax-horizontal-01.png, square https://storage.googleapis.com/adspirer-images-v1/ai-generated/2025-12-21/meta_1x1_1200x1200_113906.png and https://storage.googleapis.com/adspirer-images-v1/ai-generated/2025-12-21/meta_1x1_1200x1200_132953.png, square logo https://i.postimg.cc/wThqRmL6/Adspirer-square.png.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the account's existing assets, validates the provided landscape, square and logo images, writes headlines (up to 30 characters), long headlines (up to 90) and descriptions (up to 80), shows the plan, then creates a Performance Max campaign in PAUSED status with a 50 per day budget in the account's currency and returns its name and ID. Nothing spends until the user turns it on.

negative.description: User asks for general marketing advice without needing ad platform data or actions. Adspirer Search Ads should not be invoked; the request needs no connected ad-account data or campaign action, so ChatGPT answers directly.
negative.prompt: What are some good marketing strategies for a small business? Should I focus on SEO or social media?

negative.description: User asks about an ad platform this plugin doesn't support. Adspirer Search Ads covers Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising only, so it should say Meta isn't supported here and return no Meta data.
negative.prompt: Show me my Meta Ads performance

negative.description: User sends a casual greeting with no advertising-related request. Adspirer Search Ads should not be invoked; ChatGPT responds conversationally without calling any tool.
negative.prompt: Hey! How's it going? What kind of things can you do?

review.commerce_description: Adspirer Search Ads does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: first release of Adspirer Search Ads for ChatGPT. Separate read and write tools for Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising, a Google Ads performance dashboard, keyword research, search-term and negative-keyword workflows, Microsoft Advertising campaign management, a conversion tracking audit, and read access to Google Analytics 4, Search Console and Tag Manager. Bundles six skills: get-started, adspirer-search-ads, google-search-campaigns, search-performance-review, search-optimization and microsoft-advertising.
